steps.code:
# Parse each file and reorganize
import re

meetings_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=meetings_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)

for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # Create directory named after file_name (without extension)
    new_dir = meetings_dir + file_name
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file name: date.extension
    new_filename = date_part + ('.' + ext if ext else '')
    destination = new_dir + '/' + new_filename
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=destination)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {destination}")
